subject: Rivermoor turnup: private network & on‑prem appliance checklist
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Ellis <sam.ellis@rivermoor.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Jun 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Rivermoor turnup: private network & on‑prem appliance checklist

Hi Sam —

Thanks for confirming the go‑ahead for the private deployment. Per our call, I’m starting the turnup thread so we have a single place for configuration, timelines, and any last‑minute items before we ship the on‑prem appliance.

High‑level asks for the next 72 hours:
- Confirm public IP range and answer whether NAT will be applied (we need the exact external translation if present).
- Share the BGP ASN and expected prefix advertisement schedule if you plan to announce routes.
- Provide the CIDR you want for the VPC peering connection and the desired internal DNS suffix (e.g., internal.rivermoor.local).
- Confirm the target maintenance window for initial appliance handoff (we recommended 02:00–05:00 UTC).

I’ve attached a preliminary checklist and a blank runbook (appliance-install-checklist.pdf, runbook-ports-and-routes.xlsx) and a VPC diagram (rivermoor_vpc_diagram.vsdx). Please review and drop comments directly in the Drive folder.

Next steps from our side: Monica will schedule the connectivity dry‑run, Vivek will review firewall/port requirements and supply firewall rules in a separate e‑mail, and I’ll coordinate the hardware courier + on‑site contact details.

If anything on the checklist is a hard blocker for your security/compliance team, flag it now and we’ll escalate.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Technical Program Manager, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com | +1 415‑555‑0123

Attachments: appliance-install-checklist.pdf (draft), rivermoor_vpc_diagram.vsdx (draft), runbook-ports-and-routes.xlsx (template)

From: Sam Ellis <sam.ellis@rivermoor.com>

Cc: Nate Cole <nate.cole@rivermoor.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Jun 2028 09:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Rivermoor turnup: private network & on‑prem appliance checklist

Jordan —

Appreciate the checklist and clarity. A few quick answers while we gather the remaining artifacts:
- We will NAT the appliance egress through our existing edge; I’ll confirm the external NAT mapping by EOD.
- BGP: not announcing new prefixes for this turnup — the appliance will use existing LloydNet uplinks. No ASN changes.
- VPC CIDR for peering: 10.40.0.0/16. Internal DNS: rivermoor.internal.corp.
- Maintenance window: Sunday 2028‑06‑24 02:00–05:00 UTC works for our infra ops team.

I’ve asked our security operations to run the VPC diagram by the compliance folks; they may request a tighter egress policy. I’ll loop back with any redlines.

Also: do you have a checklist for certificate provisioning and KMS integration for the appliance? We need to ensure HSM/KMS access patterns are validated before handoff.

—Sam
Sam Ellis
Infrastructure Lead
Rivermoor Health
sam.ellis@rivermoor.com

Thanks Sam — good quick responses. I’ve scheduled a 60‑minute dry‑run for Thursday 2028‑06‑29 at 15:00 PDT / 22:00 UTC (calendar invite sent to the infra@rivermoor.com alias).

Vivek — can you review the port list in the runbook and confirm the minimal set we require for initial validation? I’ll own the dry‑run script and capture timestamps for each validation step (BGP/peers, peering handshake, API reachability, telemetry tunnel, and KMS attest).

Sam — to answer your KMS question: we support both customer‑managed KMS via IAM roles and external HSM broker flows. For the turnup we typically perform a PKI smoke test:
- Exchange CSR and validate cert chain on a pre‑production endpoint
- Confirm TLS/MTLS handshake from the appliance to our control plane
- Confirm encryption at rest keys are present and accessible during bootstrap (we do not persist keys off appliance without your consent)

I’ve attached a short KMS checklist to the Drive folder and put notes in column C of the runbook spreadsheet.

Jordan — I’ll capture any security requests from Rivermoor and escalate to Product if we need a change to the appliance agent.

Monica Patel
Senior Implementation Manager, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com | +1 617‑555‑0167
